name: lv4ad-3-enrich-links
description: Add wikilinks from an already-formatted LV4AD chapter page (from lv4ad-2-format-chapter) out to other entities already in the garden — tools, commands, people, GitHub repos, concepts like RSI — following logseq-link-hygiene. Use when the user asks to link up, enrich, or connect an [[LV4AD/Ch/...]] page after it's already been formatted into blockquote + [[My Note]] / [[AI Notes]] shape. Only adds links to existing or clearly-warranted stub pages; never rewrites highlight/note text or heading structure.
